title: Route_15
lead_summary:
This connects Route 14 to Fuchsia City.
Although there is water, there is no fishing catch table.
To reach the Creepy House, the player will need Rock Smash, Strength and Surf (or their HM Replacement Items).
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.
